verdict.rationale: Fern generates API Reference documentation from OpenAPI/GraphQL specs (fern-docs-22, fern-docs-9), and the docs platform serves interactive-style content, but the evidence pack never documents a 'try it now' / runnable code execution feature within the API reference — nothing describes live request sandboxes or executable examples. missing for 10: explicit evidence of runnable/try-it code examples embedded in the API reference, evidence of interactive request builder or live execution against real endpoints.
